radius.$description: Semantic corner-radius roles for controls, surfaces, and pills.

none.$description: radius-none — sharp corners (tables, dense data UI)

sm.$description: radius-sm — subtle rounding for compact controls

md.$description: radius-md — default rounding for buttons and inputs

lg.$description: radius-lg — softer rounding for cards and panels

rounded.$description: radius-rounded — fully rounded pills and avatars
